rationale: Create one canonical Outpost Solar record for the 629 MW operating Webb County project. Repsol's first-half 2026 report directly confirms that Stonepeak's 43.8% acquisition closed in February 2026; retain Repsol as the continuing joint-control owner and identify its 56.2% only as the arithmetic remainder, not a separately disclosed stake.

supports: Stonepeak's 43.8% acquisition closed in February 2026 after conditions were satisfied
The completed transfer consideration was approximately $253 million

evidence.purpose: Manager strategy, signed transaction and asset operating evidence.
supports: Stonepeak signed to acquire 43.8% on December 11, 2025
Outpost is a 629 MW Webb County solar facility operating under a long-term PPA
Outpost Solar SellCo LLC was the transaction target
The share purchase created Stonepeak/Repsol joint control

evidence.purpose: State record for the underlying project entity and Texas location.
supports: Hecate Energy Outpost Solar LLC is the underlying Webb County project entity

afterImage.name: Outpost Solar
afterImage.description: Outpost Solar is a 629 MW utility-scale photovoltaic generation project in Webb County, Texas that began commercial operations in August 2025 and sells electricity under a long-term power purchase agreement. Stonepeak acquired a 43.8% interest from Repsol in February 2026 for approximately $253 million, creating joint control with Repsol through Outpost Solar SellCo LLC.

ownershipPeriods.stake: Continuing joint-control interest; 56.2% arithmetic remainder, not separately disclosed

milestones.event: The 629 MW Outpost Solar project began commercial operations under a long-term power purchase agreement.
Stonepeak signed to acquire a 43.8% interest in Outpost Solar from Repsol for $252.5 million.
Competition authorities in China and the European Union cleared the Stonepeak transaction.
Stonepeak completed its acquisition of a 43.8% joint-control interest after the transaction conditions were satisfied.
